data.name: Honorbound: The Knight’s Tale
data.detailed_description:
Honorbound: The Knight’s Tale is a story-driven open-world action RPG inspired by the history of 14th century medieval.
You play as a betrayed knight searching for truth, redemption, and a path back to honor in a land torn by war, loyalty, and destiny.

Explore a handcrafted world filled with rugged mountains, forgotten monasteries, dense forests, and battle-scarred villages. Every location holds secrets, stories, and choices that shape who you become.

Forge alliances, uncover conspiracies, and face powerful enemies in a brutal combat system rooted in medieval weaponry and survival tactics. Every strike, parry, and decision carries weight — and every action can bring you closer to redemption… or drag you further into darkness.

The world does not wait for you.
It remembers.
It judges.
And it offers many paths — but not all of them are peaceful.

AI Generated Content Disclosure:

Optional generative AI voiceover may be used during the Early Access period.

All other game content is handcrafted by the development team.

data.short_description: Honorbound: The Knight’s Tale is an Open World Action RPG set in the medieval 14th century, where you can fully immerse yourself in a land shaped by war, loyalty, and destiny. Explore a vast handcrafted world, uncover secrets, forge reputation, and unravel the conspiracy that shattered your honor.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i5-7500 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580 (4–6GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 25 GB available space MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Early Access performance and optimization are still in progress.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i7-9700K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM MB RAM
  • Graphics: VIDIA RTX 2060 / AMD RX 5700
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 25 GB available space MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Recommended settings for smoother performance in larger environments.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains medieval combat, depictions of injury, and moderate blood. Battles involve swords, shields, and historical weaponry. There are no sexual themes or explicit sexual content. Players sensitive to violence, war themes, or realistic depictions of injury should be aware that these elements appear throughout the game’s story and setting.
